Title: Heart pounding or skipping at rest? It's probably not arrhythmia - 3 calming habits

Description:
Feeling your heart suddenly race or skip a beat, even when nothing startled you? If tests come back normal, that's usually palpitations, not arrhythmia - and three everyday habits are the most common cause.

Caffeine, stress, and lack of sleep all push your nervous system into overdrive. Here's why each one matters, and what actually helps calm it down.
